verdict.rationale: Rainforest advertises a pre-built embeddable 'reporting' component alongside payments, chargebacks, and onboarding, implying some seller-facing financial visibility, but the docs pack contains no specifics on per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper-ready exports. Missing for 10: documentation of statement generation, reconciliation report format/fields, and export capabilities (CSV/PDF) for bookkeepers.
